title: Aalukkoru Aasai
desc: Arivazhagan plans on leading a happy life by choosing an independent educated girl as his partner. However, his orthodox grandparents trick him into marrying an illiterate woman.

title: Ambigai Neril Vanthaal
desc: After a lot of persuasion, Devaki agrees to marry Ravi. However, the marriage becomes a bitter struggle for her when she comes to know that Ravi is a drunkard and a womaniser.

title: Sangamam
desc: Selvam, a rural folk artist, falls in love with Abhirami, a classical dancer. However, things become complicated when her father disapproves of their relationship.

title: Manmatha Leelai
desc: Madhu is married to Rekha and unbeknownst to her, he is a womaniser who despite his marital status pursues romantic escapades with other women.

title: Simmaraasi
desc: A man's campaign against the caste system earns him much respect from the villagers. Years later, his son who has joined the village goon returns from the city with an arrest warrant for his father.
